Builds with GCC 13, and goes to the package registries. Same API and ABI as
0.1.2.

### Fixes

- RTXUI now configures and builds with GCC 13, Ubuntu 24.04's default
  compiler. CMake used to stop at configure time: the probe for C++26
  reflection asked for a C++ dialect GCC 13 does not have. GCC 13 is now
  tested in CI.
- On Windows, the DLL build (`BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON`) and the Bazel build
  are now tested in CI. Their only failures were in RTXUI's own tests,
  now fixed: with `BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON`, the test binary could not find
  Catch2's DLL, and under Bazel it could not find its data files.

### Package registries

From this release on, each release is handed to package registries by
`.github/workflows/publish.yml`:

- **xmake-repo**: a pull request per release.
- **Bazel Central Registry**: through publish-to-bcr.
- **Homebrew**: `brew install arthursonzogni/tap/rtxui`, from
  [ArthurSonzogni/homebrew-tap](https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/homebrew-tap).
- **AUR**: [`rtxui`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/rtxui), updated on
  each release.
- **conda-forge** and **nixpkgs**: submitted with this release, then kept up
  to date by their bots.

Each takes effect once the registry's maintainers merge it.

### Packages

| File | What it holds |
| :--- | :--- |
| `rtxui-0.1.3-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Debug and Release static libraries, headers, CMake package, pkg-config file |
| `rtxui-0.1.3-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.3-macos-universal.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 and x86_64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.3-windows-x64.zip` | The same, built with MSVC (`/MD` runtime; `rtxuid.lib` for Debug) |
| `rtxui-0.1.3-windows-arm64.zip` | The same, for arm64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.3-windows-x64-mingw.zip` | The same, built with MinGW-w64 GCC, UCRT, as MSYS2's UCRT64 |
| `librtxui-dev_0.1.3_amd64.deb`, `librtxui-dev_0.1.3_arm64.deb` | Release library for Debian and Ubuntu |
| `rtxui-devel-0.1.3-1.x86_64.rpm`, `rtxui-devel-0.1.3-1.aarch64.rpm` | Release library for Fedora and other RPM distributions |
| `rtxui-0.1.3.tar.gz` | The source, as committed |

Before publishing, the release installs each .deb on Ubuntu 24.04 and each
.rpm on Fedora, and builds an app against each archive with
`find_package(rtxui)`, in Debug and in Release.

A prebuilt static C++ library links with a compatible compiler and standard
library: GCC or Clang with libstdc++ on Linux, Apple Clang on macOS, MSVC or
MinGW (UCRT) on Windows, each with its own archive. Otherwise, build from
source with FetchContent, as described in
[Getting started](https://arthursonzogni.github.io/RTXUI/guide/getting-started).
